name: SDP EU Withdrawal for WooCommerce
author: Simple Direct Plugins

sections.description:
SDP EU Withdrawal for WooCommerce helps WooCommerce stores manage customer withdrawal requests in a structured and compliant way. Built specifically around the EU withdrawal process, not generic return handling.

Customers can submit withdrawal requests directly from their account area, while administrators receive clear notifications and a dedicated review interface to process each case efficiently.

The plugin is especially useful for stores selling physical goods, mixed products, or downloadable products where withdrawal eligibility may depend on customer actions such as accepting digital content waivers or downloading files.

Everything is designed to fit naturally into WooCommerce without unnecessary complexity.

⚙️ Features

  • Allow customers to submit withdrawal requests directly from their WooCommerce account.
  • Optional guest checkout support with secure token-based access.
  • Dedicated admin review screen for each withdrawal request.
  • Approve or reject requests with optional administrator comments.
  • Customer email notifications for request submission, approval, and rejection.
  • Mandatory administrator notifications for pending requests.
  • Configurable withdrawal eligibility period.
  • Support for downloadable product withdrawal waivers.
  • Automatic download activity detection for downloadable products.
  • Product-level exclusion from withdrawal requests.
  • Visual urgency indicators for pending and expired requests.
  • Complete request log with customer actions, notifications, and review history.
  • Direct integration with WooCommerce orders.
  • Integration with WordPress Privacy Tools (Export Personal Data and Erase Personal Data)
  • Translation ready.
  • Completely translated into Spanish.

💎 Pro Version

Unlock the full potential of SDP EU Withdrawal Pro with these advanced features:

  • Centralized withdrawal request management dashboard.
  • Structured item-level withdrawal requests.
  • Advanced forensic and compliance data logging.
  • Reminder notifications for unresolved requests.
  • Multiple administrator notification recipients.
  • Additional administrative workflow tools.
  • Premium integrations and automation features.

Upgrade now to streamline your withdrawal request workflow.
sections.faq:
Can guests submit withdrawal requests?

Yes. If guest checkout is enabled in WooCommerce and guest support is enabled in the plugin settings, guest customers can securely submit and review withdrawal requests.

Does the plugin support downloadable products?

Yes. The plugin includes specific handling for downloadable products, including digital withdrawal waiver support and download activity checks.

Can I prevent withdrawal requests for digital products?

Yes. The plugin includes digital product withdrawal waiver support, allowing you to handle downloadable products differently when legally applicable. Download activity before the withdrawal request is recorded and visible in the request review screen for full administrative oversight.

Does this plugin process refunds automatically?

No. The plugin manages the withdrawal request workflow, not payment refunds.

Refund processing remains under your normal WooCommerce/payment gateway workflow.

Can administrators approve or reject requests manually?

Yes. Each request includes a dedicated admin review screen with approval and rejection actions, plus optional customer-facing comments.

Can the plugin be translated into other languages?

Yes, it’s fully compatible with translation files and multilingual plugins such as WPML, and comes with a complete Spanish translation included.
